name: Edge stop: a turn into a hanging wall's bottom edge takes all the rise
techNote: A hanging Ground wall (x -50-50, bottom y 120) over a floor. Jump with your back to it (hitbox back edge 2 u from its side), and on tick 4, rising at 697 with the hitbox top 7 u above the wall's bottom, turn into it (stick full toward it; the jump let go): the turn swings the hitbox (offset x 5) 10 u into the wall, and the overlap is shallower upward (7) than sideways (8), so the depenetration pushes the dot down out of the wall's bottom face. The contact is then a ceiling (normal (0, -1)) and OnCollisionStay2D zeroes Velocity.y and momentum.y: the jump stops dead 95 u up and the dot slides under the wall and lands. The same turn a tick earlier bonks the bottom face plainly from under it, and two ticks later (hitbox top 40 u past the edge) it is pushed out sideways and the jump rises on up the wall's side.
